history.summary: A large 1,399 sqft 3BR at Aljunied MRT's doorstep (150m), priced at $1.69M / $1,208 PSF — ~13% below the $1,381 URA median. The unbeatable MRT proximity and family-sized layout are real strengths, offset by an ageing 99yr lease (built 2001, ~74yr left) and a 38-txn appreciation read.
history.rating_rationale: 150m to Aljunied MRT (EW line, two stops to the CBD fringe) is a premier transit location that anchors both rental and resale demand. PSF $1,208 is ~13% under the $1,381 median, and the $1.69M quantum sits in the liquid sweet spot for a genuine 3-bedder. URA +4.07%/yr over 38 txns is a moderately reliable, healthy rate. Main caveat: 99yr from 2001 means lease decay starts to matter on a 5-7yr exit (~67yr left at sale).

history.summary: A genuinely-cheap large 1,399sqft 3BR in D14 - asking PSF verifiably below the project's recent transactions - but the ageing 99-yr-from-1997 lease tempers the case to a value Buy, not a strong one.
history.rating_rationale: The cheapness is real: asking $1,208 psf vs project 12-month average ~$1,416 psf (3BR listings $1,318-$1,809 psf, high of $1,517 in Jul 2025) is roughly 15% below market, corroborating the -19.6% age-adj and -12.8% psf-vs-cohort figures (cohort of 7 txns - thin-ish but not a single-comp quirk). A large 1,399sqft 3BR at a sub-$1.7m absolute quantum is a rare entry point in central-fringe D14, near Aljunied (EW9) and Paya Lebar interchange (CC/EW). The 'very_low_psf' flag here reads as genuine value given verified comps, not a mis-scrape. The offset is the 'very_old_property' flag: 99-yr lease from 1997 leaves only ~70 yrs, so lease decay and financing/CPF limits will weigh on exit liquidity over a 5-7yr hold, and the 2001-vintage building lacks modern facilities. On balance the verified discount and large quantum-efficient layout outweigh the lease concern for a value buyer, but the decay is why this is a measured Buy at medium confidence rather than higher.
